products.name: SSL/TLS Inspection & Decryption Rollout (Netskope) — Commercial
products.short_description: A safe SSL/TLS inspection and decryption rollout in Netskope — deploy the inspection certificate via Intune, build decryption policy with the right do-not-decrypt bypasses, and validate before enforcing. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
See into encrypted traffic — safely, without breaking the apps that can't be decrypted

Almost all web traffic is encrypted, so without inspection your secure web gateway is largely blind. But turning on decryption carelessly breaks certificate-pinned apps and creates privacy and compliance problems. This solution delivers a safe SSL/TLS inspection and decryption rollout in Netskope — deploy the inspection certificate via Intune, build decryption policy with the right do-not-decrypt bypasses (banking, health, pinned apps), and validate before enforcing.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — why decryption matters, how Netskope SSL/TLS inspection works, the inspection certificate trust chain, decryption policy and do-not-decrypt bypass categories, and privacy/compliance considerations.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Netskope tenant + SWG, the inspection certificate, Intune for cert deployment, a bypass list source, a pilot group, change control) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: deploy the inspection certificate to endpoints, build decryption policy and bypass lists, steer pilot traffic, validate apps and user experience, then pilot, validate, and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — certificate/decryption-readiness discovery, certificate-trust and decryption validation, a decryption coverage and bypass report, safe remediation (deploy/repair cert), and a target group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Encrypted traffic made inspectable — the inspection certificate trusted on every device, decryption policy enforced with the right bypasses for pinned/sensitive apps — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • NSSSL-Discovery.ps1 — SSL inspection certificate-trust and decryption readiness on this device
    • NSSSL-Remediation.ps1 — safely request an MDM sync so the inspection-cert profile re-applies
    • NSSSL-Report.ps1 — fleet certificate-trust deployment + decryption-readiness inventory (Graph)
    • NSSSL-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — build/populate the pilot + production scope groups (Graph)
    • NSSSL-Validation.ps1 — confirm the inspection root is trusted and its chain validates

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
